name.zh: 5. 研发与供应链协同（DFM/DFA/早期导入）
name.en: 5. R&D and Supply Chain Collaboration (DFM/DFA/Early Involvement)

intent.zh: 确认设计阶段即考虑可制造性、可装配性与可得性，二供与工装同步
intent.en: Ensure design phases account for manufacturability, assembly, and availability with second sourcing and tooling in sync.

questions.id: scm-是否进行跨部门-dfm-dfa-评审-rd-me-pe-qa-scm-并确保结论整改闭环

text.zh: 是否进行跨部门 DFM/DFA 评审（RD/ME/PE/QA/SCM），并确保结论整改闭环？
text.en: Do we run cross-functional DFM/DFA reviews (RD/ME/PE/QA/SCM) and close out the resulting actions?

zh.1: 未开展跨部门 DFM/DFA 评审，设计制造冲突未识别。
zh.2: 偶尔召开评审但参会部门不全，整改缺乏记录。
zh.3: 建立跨部门评审并形成整改清单，部分闭环。
zh.4: 评审结论按责任闭环并追踪验证，工艺约束纳入设计基线。
zh.5: DFM/DFA 评审数据化沉淀，问题趋势与经验库驱动设计优化。

en.1: No cross-functional DFM/DFA reviews; design-manufacturing conflicts go unnoticed.
en.2: Reviews occur sporadically with incomplete participation and no remediation record.
en.3: Cross-functional reviews exist with action lists and partial closure.
en.4: Review conclusions close by owner with tracked verification; process constraints feed the design baseline.
en.5: DFM/DFA reviews capture data that drives design optimization via trends and lessons learned.

focus: 跨部门 DFM/DFA 评审机制
制造约束纳入设计基线
ask: 评审参与角色有哪些？
整改闭环如何追踪？
threshold: 关键可制造风险闭环并有复盘

focus: Manufacturing constraints built into the design baseline
ask: Who participates in the reviews?
How is remediation closure tracked?
threshold: Critical manufacturability risks are closed with retrospectives

questions.id: scm-早期供应商参与-esi-产能-交期-生命周期-替代评估是否纳入设计约束

text.zh: 早期供应商参与（ESI）：产能/交期/生命周期/替代评估是否纳入设计约束？
text.en: Does early supplier involvement (ESI) feed capacity/lead-time/lifecycle/substitution assessments into design constraints?

zh.1: 无早期供应商参与，设计阶段缺供方输入。
zh.2: 仅在样机阶段邀请供应商，产能或交期评估缺失。
zh.3: 制定 ESI 计划，涵盖产能、交期与生命周期评估。
zh.4: 供应商评估结果纳入设计约束，措施闭环并有记录。
zh.5: ESI 数据与项目计划联动，供应能力变化实时预警。

en.1: No early supplier involvement; design lacks supplier input.
en.2: Suppliers engaged only at prototype stage, missing capacity or lead-time assessments.
en.3: ESI plan covers capacity, lead-time, and lifecycle assessments.
en.4: Supplier assessment results become design constraints with documented closure.
en.5: ESI data links with project plans, providing real-time supply capability alerts.

focus: 产能/交期/生命周期评估
等效性验证覆盖功能/可靠性
ask: ESI 包含哪些关键评估？
评估结果如何反馈给设计？
二供验证包含哪些测试？
切换判据如何设定？
threshold: 产能/生命周期评估完成并落实约束
关键物料二供通过验证并备案

focus: Equivalence validation covers function and reliability
ask: What key assessments are in ESI?
How are assessment results fed back into design?
Which tests are included in second-source validation?
How are switch criteria defined?
threshold: Capacity and lifecycle assessments are complete with constraints applied
Critical components pass second-source validation with records filed

questions.id: scm-关键物料二供策略是否在设计阶段完成等效性验证-功能-可靠性-一致性

text.zh: 关键物料二供策略是否在设计阶段完成等效性验证（功能/可靠性/一致性）？
text.en: Does the second-source strategy validate equivalence (function/reliability/consistency) during design?

zh.1: 无二供策略或仅口头约定。
zh.2: 识别潜在二供但未验证等效性。
zh.3: 关键物料二供完成功能验证并记录。
zh.4: 二供验证覆盖可靠性与一致性，切换流程明确。
zh.5: 二供能力纳入风险矩阵，量产状态持续监控与回写。

en.1: No second-source strategy or only verbal agreements.
en.2: Potential second sources identified without equivalence validation.
en.3: Critical components complete functional validation with records.
en.4: Second-source validation covers reliability and consistency with clear switch procedures.
en.5: Second-source capability feeds the risk matrix with ongoing production monitoring and feedback.

focus: 等效性验证覆盖功能/可靠性
ask: 二供验证包含哪些测试？
切换判据如何设定？
threshold: 关键物料二供通过验证并备案

focus: Equivalence validation covers function and reliability
ask: Which tests are included in second-source validation?
How are switch criteria defined?
threshold: Critical components pass second-source validation with records filed

questions.id: scm-试产前工装-治具-ict-fct-需求与验收标准是否明确并完成验收

text.zh: 试产前工装/治具/ICT/FCT 需求与验收标准是否明确并完成验收？
text.en: Are pilot-build tooling/fixtures/ICT/FCT requirements defined with acceptance criteria and completed acceptance?

zh.1: 试产前工装/治具需求未识别或无标准。
zh.2: 有工装需求但验收标准缺失，交付常延误。
zh.3: 工装/ICT/FCT 需求明确定义并完成基本验收。
zh.4: 验收标准量化且闭环，试产前完成调试与培训。
zh.5: 工装状态数字化管理，与试产/量产良率数据联动。

en.1: Pilot-build tooling/fixture needs are unidentified or lack standards.
en.2: Tooling needs exist but acceptance criteria are missing, delaying delivery.
en.3: Tooling/ICT/FCT requirements are defined with basic acceptance completed.
en.4: Acceptance criteria are quantified with closure; tuning and training finish before pilot builds.
en.5: Tooling status is digitized and linked to pilot/production yield data.

focus: 工装/治具/ICT/FCT 需求定义
ask: 验收标准如何量化？
试产前如何确认产能与稳定性？
规范如何归档与受控？
版本更新如何通知到项目？
threshold: 关键工装在试产前完成验收并具备量产能力
关键设计规范受控且及时更新

ask: How are acceptance criteria quantified?
How do we confirm capacity and stability before pilot build?
How are standards archived and controlled?
How are version updates communicated to projects?
threshold: Critical tooling passes acceptance before pilot build and supports mass production
Critical design standards are controlled and updated promptly
